notes: AWLS-SDST stage 3: improve quality by adapting the active same-machine N7 scoring path.
The default worker-loop AWLS command uses same_machine_eval=stable, so this slot targets same_machine_evaluate_stable.
Only awls_sdst_same_machine_evaluation is user-confirmed in this manifest.

slots.title: AWLS-SDST setup-aware same-machine N7 scoring
slots.purpose: Rank AWLS same-machine critical-block moves with setup-aware cost information so N7 moves account for sequence-dependent setup gaps inside the changed local machine sequence.
inputs: move: Move whose method is FRONT or BACK and whose which/where nodes are on the same machine
local_sequence_after_same_machine_move(schedule, move): changed local segment plus external predecessor/successor
outputs: A numeric same-machine move score where smaller is preferred by find_move.
No mutation of schedule or global state.
Standard FJSP behavior should remain close to the original stable evaluator when no setup data exists.
invariants: Keep local_sequence_after_same_machine_move, move generation, legality filters, parser, evaluator, solution schema, CLI arguments, and benchmark semantics unchanged.
If the slot calls setup_time_between, import it locally inside the slot; do not assume a module-level import exists.
Move method values are string constants FRONT and BACK, not integers.
Never call setup_time_between with current_op=None; first/last machine positions have zero missing-edge setup.
For exact scoring, use trial.makespan after trial.apply_move(move); do not read trial.end_time[trial.index.end_node].
Do not change change_machine_evaluate_parts, same_machine_evaluate_cpp_fast, or zi policy in this stage.
allowed_edits: Only rewrite code between awls_sdst_same_machine_evaluation markers.
May add local helper functions or lambdas inside the slot.
May import setup_time_between locally inside the slot.
May call setup_time_between(instance, machine_id, previous_op, current_op, schedule.index).
May map AWLS node ids to operation keys using schedule.index.node_to_job and schedule.index.node_to_op.
May clone the schedule and apply move to get exact setup-aware makespan for this candidate, if errors are handled locally.
May add setup-aware propagation inside the local new_r/new_q computation for the changed local sequence.
forbidden_edits: Do not create helper files for setup parsing or move evaluation.
Do not change AwlsSchedule.update_time in this stage.
Do not change change_machine_evaluate_parts in this stage.
Do not change same_machine_evaluate_cpp_fast in this stage.
Do not change zi policy in this stage.
Do not touch harness_agent.standard_fjsp or examples/standard_fjsp_evaluator.py.
